what: A wait is negative, `NaN`, not finite, or above {@link MAX_WAIT_MS}.
fix: Pass a finite wait from 0 up to `MAX_WAIT_MS` (about 24.8 days). For a longer wait, sleep again when the timer fires.

what: Work was cut short by its `AbortSignal` before it finished: a `sleep`, a `scoped` body, or an `all` / `mapConcurrent` / `race` / `timeout` call. `cause` is `signal.reason`.
fix: Catch `AsyncError` with this code where you abort, or check `signal.aborted` before you start the work.

what: One or more `scoped` finalizers threw. `errors` holds them; `cause` is the body error, if any.
fix: Read `error.errors` for each finalizer failure and `error.cause` for the body failure. Make the failing finalizer safe to run twice.

what: A `timeout` deadline passed before the task finished.
fix: Raise the deadline or speed up the task. Make the task honor its signal so it stops at the deadline.

what: A `concurrency` limit is not a positive integer or `Infinity`.
fix: Pass a whole number of at least 1, or leave `concurrency` out for no limit.

what: `MockClock.advance` or `advanceAsync` got a negative or non-finite number of milliseconds.
fix: Pass a step that is zero or more. Use `setNow` to move the mock clock back.

what: `setTimer` or `sleep` got a delay that is negative, not finite, or longer than a timer can hold.
fix: Pass a finite delay from 0 up to `MAX_TIMER_MS` (about 24.8 days). Split a longer wait into steps.

what: Legacy abort exception code; sleep now returns SleepCancelled.
fix: Handle SleepCancelled returned from sleep.

what: `defineId` got a non-string prefix.
fix: Supply the exact stored prefix as a string; use `''` for unprefixed IDs.

what: `assertUniqueIdPrefixes` found two prefixes that are equal or start one another.
fix: Give each id kind a prefix that does not start another one.

what: Reserved legacy exception code; ID generation now returns RandomSourceUnavailable.
fix: Provide Web Crypto getRandomValues; application-owned secure providers must fail closed in every supported mode.

what: `keyset` got no keys.
fix: Declare at least one key. Order by NOT NULL columns and end on a unique one.

what: Reserved legacy exception code; cursor decoding now returns InvalidCursor.
fix: Send back a cursor exactly as the same keyset returned it, or start from the first page.

what: A contract key contains `.` or uses a reserved name.
fix: Rename the contract key: no `.`, and not a name the query utils reserve.

what: `operationOf` got a value that carries no operation.
fix: Pass a leaf of `createOrpcUtils`, or an object built by `operations()`.

what: The Drizzle column builder has no runtime config for its schema metadata.
fix: Use a supported Drizzle column builder and matching Drizzle version.

what: `defineId` received a missing, empty or non-string domain kind.
fix: Supply a non-empty literal domain name, such as `billing.refund`.

what: `defineId` received an unsupported generation format.
fix: Use 'uuid', omit format, or supply 2–256 distinct non-surrogate UTF-16 alphabet characters and an integer length of 1–256.

what: A `configure` hook attempted async work (returned a Promise).
fix: Make `configure` synchronous and move async work to `boot`.

what: A `configure` hook threw.
fix: Fix the plugin's config or its `configure` hook, then build a new app.

what: A `boot` hook threw.
fix: Read `cause` and `plugin`, then fix that plugin's `boot` hook or the service it opens.

what: A `start` hook threw.
fix: Read `cause` and `plugin`, then fix that plugin's `start` hook.

what: One or more `stop` hooks threw — aggregate.
fix: Read `failures`: each entry names the plugin whose `stop` hook threw.

what: One or more `dispose` hooks threw — aggregate.
fix: Read `failures`: each entry names the plugin whose `dispose` hook threw.

what: Caller tried to reuse the app after dispose.
fix: Build a fresh app instance; a disposed app cannot run again.

what: Caller tried to reuse the app after a failed lifecycle.
fix: Build a fresh app instance; a failed app cannot run again.

what: Plugin registered twice.
fix: Remove the second `.use()` of this plugin, or `rename` it to run two copies.

what: A plugin's `needs` entry has no provider among earlier-booted plugins.
fix: Mount a plugin that provides the needed key before its consumer.

what: A plugin published a wire key that an earlier plugin already provides.
fix: Give one of the two providers a different key with `rename`.

what: A needs alias, publish key, or rename target uses the reserved `$` prefix.
fix: Rename the key; names starting with `$` belong to the kernel.

what: A lifecycle hook exceeded the app's `hookTimeoutMs` watchdog.
fix: Pass the hook's `$signal` to its I/O, or raise `hookTimeoutMs` with a reason.

what: Two actions in the same binding use the same id.
fix: Give each action in a binding its own id.

what: Action metadata is not JSON-round-trip safe.
fix: Keep action `meta` plain JSON: no functions, Dates, Maps or cycles.

what: More than one plugin fills the logging slot.
fix: Keep one `log()` plugin in the app.

what: Static capability needs form a ring: a feature's need comes back around to itself.
fix: Move the shared piece into a third unit that both sides need.

what: A feature needs a capability whose (static) provider is mounted after it.
fix: Mount the provider before the unit that needs it; the message names both positions.

what: `$describeAction` named an action the calling plugin may not amend (unknown id, or not its own).
fix: Describe only actions the calling plugin declared or owns.

what: Two routers of a feature use the same key.
fix: Rename one of the two router keys.

what: Two repos of a feature use the same key.
fix: Rename one of the two repo keys.

what: Two slices of a feature use the same key.
fix: Rename one of the two slice keys.

what: A feature was declared with no slices.
fix: Add at least one slice to the feature.

what: A handle the feature needs is missing from the services bag.
fix: Mount the provider of that handle, and check the gateway's needs.

what: A need alias, infra key, provided key or entrypoint key collides with another slot or a reserved name.
fix: Rename the alias or key so it collides with nothing.

what: `override()` named a key that no infra plugin of the feature provides.
fix: Override a key that one of the feature's infra plugins provides.

what: `routerFor()`: an app-contract key is implemented by zero or several features.
fix: Give each app-contract key exactly one feature.

what: `routerFor()`: a feature's contract is not mounted in the app contract.
fix: Mount the feature's contract in the app contract.

what: `rpc()`: a procedure's contract `meta` is not plain JSON, so `dot explain` cannot show it.
fix: Keep the procedure's contract `meta` plain JSON.

what: The env failed its schema at boot. The message lists every bad key.
fix: Set the listed variables, or fix their values, before booting the app.

what: `defineFailure` got an empty code, or the reserved code `ok`.
fix: Give the failure a non-empty dotted code such as `post.not_found`, and not `ok`.

what: `defineFailure` got a status that is not an integer from 400 to 599.
fix: Pass an integer status from 400 to 599, or leave `status` out for the default 400.

what: `match` met a failure code it has no handler for. The types stop this, so it happens only when they were bypassed.
fix: Add a handler for the code to `match`, or fix the cast that hid it from the compiler.

what: `unreachable` was reached, so a value the types said could not happen did happen (often bad data from outside).
fix: Handle the new case in the `switch`, or validate the data at the boundary.

what: Two definitions with the same code were given where codes must be unique.
fix: Give each definition its own code, or pass the definition only once.
Check the stored data against the schema. A schema that transforms its input cannot read its own output.
Use a schema that validates synchronously for failure data.

what: An `invariant` condition was falsy, so code relied on something that is not true.
fix: Find the caller that broke the assumption and fix it; do not catch this error.

what: `configure()` ran a second time on the same logging instance.
fix: Call `configure()` once at the app entry, with `{ owner: import.meta.url }` so a dev re-run of the entry is allowed. Use `reconfigure()` on its handle to change the setup.

what: A category rule or `to()` names a channel that `configure({ channels })` does not define.
fix: Add the channel to `configure({ channels })`, or use one of the defined names.

what: A level is neither one of the six names nor a severity number from 1 to 24.
fix: Use `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error` or `fatal`, or a number from 1 to 24.

what: `fakeLog()` ran while another fake was active, or `configure()` ran while a fake owns the instance.
fix: Restore the active fake first with `restore()` or `using`. Keep one fake at a time.

what: `reconfigure()` was called on a handle that no longer owns the configuration.
fix: Use the handle returned by the latest `configure()` call.

what: A string is not a number in the accepted syntax.
fix: Pass a plain ASCII decimal string such as `'12.5'` or `'1e3'`, or parse locale text with `@arki/math/parse`.
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: An argument is outside what the function accepts.
fix: Read the message for the argument and fix its value: bounds in order, a positive step, a probability from 0 to 1.
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: Division by zero, or zero raised to a negative power.
fix: Check the divisor before the call, or choose a result for the zero case in your own code.
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: The exact result needs rounding and no rounding mode was given.
fix: Pass a scale and a rounding mode, for example `{ scale: 4, rounding: 'halfEven' }`.
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: A value cannot be represented in the target type.
fix: Use a `bigint` or `Decimal` input, or keep the value inside the safe integer and finite float range.
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: A statistic was asked of an empty or too small data set.
fix: Check the data length first. Most statistics need one value; variance and regression need more.
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: An input or result exceeds the documented digit limits.
fix: Keep values within 10 000 digits and an exponent of 10 000. These limits guard against hostile input.
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: The runtime lacks an `Intl` feature this call depends on.
fix: Pass `symbols` to parse without `Intl`, or use a runtime with the feature (Hermes on iOS lacks `formatToParts`).
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: A matrix is singular to working precision.
fix: Check the matrix with `conditionNumber` or `rank`, or use `leastSquares` or `pseudoInverse`.
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: An iterative method did not reach its tolerance.
fix: Read `.best` for the best estimate, widen the tolerance or iteration limit, or give a better starting bracket.
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: A matrix that must be symmetric positive definite is not.
fix: Pass a symmetric positive definite matrix, or use LU or QR decomposition instead of Cholesky.
verify: cd packages/math && bun run vitest run src/errors.test.ts

what: The circuit breaker is open and rejected the call.
fix: Wait for the breaker to half-open and call again, or serve a fallback with `withFallback` while it is open.

what: A timeout policy reached its deadline.
fix: Raise `timeoutMs`, or make the operation faster. Pass the policy's `signal` to the work so it stops.

what: The caller's own signal aborted the call.
fix: Check `signal.aborted` before you start, or catch `CancelledError` where you abort. It is not an outage.

what: A bulkhead had no free execution or queue slot.
fix: Retry later, raise `maxConcurrent` or the queue size, or shed load before the call.

what: Every retry attempt failed.
fix: Read `lastError` for the real cause, or raise the `upTo` limit.

what: A `backoff` builder got an option or an attempt number it cannot use.
fix: Pass finite, non-negative numbers: `jitter` from 0 to 1, a whole number to `upTo`, attempts from 1.

what: `for` or `run` got a name that is not in the presets (only reachable from untyped JS).
fix: Use a name you passed to `definePresets(...)`. Types catch this in TypeScript.

what: A `withJsonSchema` converter was asked for a target other than draft-2020-12.
fix: Ask for the `draft-2020-12` target.

what: `assert` or `ensure` got a value the schema rejects. The value is a bug in the caller, so it throws instead of returning a failure.
fix: Read `issues` on the error, then fix the code that produced the value. Use `parse` where bad data is expected.

what: `is`, `assert` or `ensure` got a schema that validates asynchronously. They are synchronous and cannot wait for it.
fix: Use `parseAsync`, or a schema that validates synchronously.

what: An argument is outside what the function accepts (empty needle, negative length, bad glyph).
fix: Check the argument against the range in the function reference: a non-empty needle, a whole number of at least 0 for lengths.

what: Text or bytes are not valid UTF-8: an unpaired surrogate, an overlong form, a bad lead byte.
fix: Pass well-formed text with no lone surrogates, or valid UTF-8 bytes. Encoding APIs return canonical failures; narrow with `isFailure`.

what: An input is not valid strict base64: whitespace, a mixed alphabet, bad padding or an impossible length.
fix: Pass strict base64 of the chosen alphabet with correct padding. Encoding APIs return canonical failures; narrow with `isFailure`.

what: An `interpolate` template has a malformed placeholder.
fix: Write placeholders as `{{ name }}` with an identifier inside, and close every `{{` with `}}`.

what: An `interpolate` placeholder has no value and `missing` is `'throw'`.
fix: Pass a value for the placeholder, or set `missing` to `'keep'` or `'empty'`.

what: Owned execution was cancelled; the external reason stays private.
fix: Honor the signal and handle cancellation at the calling boundary.

what: An owned deadline elapsed; work still needs cooperative settlement.
fix: Allow more time or make work honor the owned signal.

what: Multiple owned failures; public counts serialize while original members stay private.
fix: Inspect the local typed cause and address every failure.

what: The run was interrupted by SIGINT or SIGTERM.
fix: Check what the interrupted run changed, then run the command again.

what: The command asks for confirmation and there is no terminal to ask on.
fix: Pass `--yes` to confirm without a terminal.

what: A required value is missing and there is no terminal to ask for it.
fix: Pass the flag named in `.error.data.flag`.

what: The command line does not fit the command's input. `issues` names each key and flag.
fix: Fix the flags named in `.error.issues`; `--help` lists them.

what: `--dry-run` on a command without `preview`.
fix: Run the command without `--dry-run`, or give the command a `preview`.

what: The command name is not one at this level. `suggestions` holds the close names and aliases.
fix: Use a name from `.error.data.suggestions`, or run `--help` to list the commands.

what: A sleep ended before its timer because its owner cancelled it.
fix: Handle cancellation at the owning operation boundary.

what: A cursor cannot be decoded for this keyset.
fix: Send back the cursor unchanged, or start from the first page.

what: A row has a missing or unrepresentable cursor key.
fix: Use non-null strings, finite numbers, booleans or valid Dates and keep the cursor within 1024 characters.

what: Secure ID generation has no usable Web Crypto provider.
fix: Provide Web Crypto getRandomValues, or randomUUID for UUID declarations; application-owned secure providers must fail closed in every supported mode.

what: `boot` ran before the kernel activated the logging slot.
fix: Mount `log()` with `.use()` in a Dot app and let the kernel run its hooks; never call them yourself.

what: Approval must be verified for this invocation, not inferred from another exposure.
fix: Verify approval bound to the caller, action and input.

what: An adapter may call only an explicitly exposed boundary.
fix: Use an adapter listed by the action contract.

what: The adapter must authenticate its caller before invoking this action.
fix: Authenticate the caller before invoking the action.

what: Importing the app file threw, or its exported factory did.
fix: Apply `.error.data.causeRemediation` when it is set; otherwise run `bun <app file>` to reproduce.

what: The app file loaded, but no export is a DOT app, or several are and none is `default` or `app`.
fix: Export the app as `default` or as `app`.

what: `configure` threw while the CLI prepared the app.
fix: Read `.error.data.underlyingCode` and look it up in the kernel error table; `ARKI_DOT_E020` means a provider is mounted after its consumer.

what: No app file at the default paths and no `--app`.
fix: Create `dot.config.ts` that exports the app, or pass `--app <path>`.

what: Another `dot dev` is alive in this project: its pid is in the state file.
fix: Stop the other `dot dev`; if its pid is not a `dot dev`, delete the file in `.error.data.statePath`.

what: The app export is already configured, booted or started: `dot dev` cannot own its lifecycle.
fix: Export the unstarted builder: no `configure()`, `boot()` or `start()` call on the `dev` export.

what: `dot dev` found no Postgres to talk to: no URL, a bad URL, or a closed port it could not start.
fix: Start the database, fix `DB_URL` in `.env`, or run `dot dev --db pglite`.

what: Something already listens on the app port, so the runner would not get it.
fix: Stop the process on that port, or pick another one with `dot dev --port <n>`.

what: The preflight process did not report a result: a crash, a hang past the timeout, or output that is not its report. Never a pass.
fix: Read `.error.data.output`, then run `dot doctor --app <file>` to see the same boot in the foreground.

what: The database is neither on this machine nor a compose service: `dot dev` would migrate it on boot.
fix: Point every database URL at this machine or a compose service, or pass `--allow-remote-db` on purpose.

what: The app runner (`vite dev`, `--run`, or `dot _serve`) could not be started.
fix: Install the runner, or pass the command that serves the app with `dot dev --run "<cmd>"`.

what: `doctor` found error-severity issues. The data is the whole report: `.error.data.plugins[]`.
fix: Apply the `remediation` of each issue in `.error.data.plugins[].issues` and `.error.data.issues`.

what: An operation tried to initialize a service after its owner closed admission.
fix: Use the handle only while its owning application is running.

what: `doctor --observability` found no OpenTelemetry SDK. Reported as a warning issue in the snapshot, not returned.
fix: Register an OpenTelemetry SDK once at app entry, before any app boots.

what: A managed preflight reported a lifecycle failure, retaining the complete report.
fix: Read `.error.data.failure.code` and apply its message; inspect `.error.data.report` for diagnostics.

what: Two plugins register different modules for one projection format.
fix: Remove one registration, or make both plugins register the same module.

what: `project(manifest)` threw or returned output that does not survive a JSON round trip.
fix: Make `project(manifest)` pure and return JSON-round-trip-safe output.

what: The projection module could not be resolved or imported, or exports no `project(manifest)`.
fix: Install the module and export a named `project(manifest)` function from it.

what: No plugin registers the `--as` format.
fix: Use a format from `.error.data.registeredFormats`, or mount the adapter that provides it.

what: Previous ownership could not be released, so starting another app is unsafe.
fix: Resolve the disposal failure before starting another owner of the resources.

what: A replaced module no longer owns the application's runtime.
fix: Obtain the runtime exported by the current module.

what: `dot new` would overwrite files in a non-empty target directory.
fix: Choose an empty directory, or re-run with `--force` to overwrite.

what: The package's bundled template directory is empty or missing.
fix: Reinstall `@arki/dot`: it must ship its `templates/` directory.

what: `dot new` could not write some files. `written` lists the ones that landed.
fix: Check the permissions of the target directory, then re-run with `--force`.

what: An external envelope cannot be trusted as a known failure.
fix: Send a supported failure envelope with validated JSON data.

what: A caught operation defect, distinct from the UnexpectedFailure exception bridge.
fix: Inspect the private cause and fix the operation.

what: A synchronous operation received an asynchronous validator result.
fix: Use parseAsync() and await the result.

what: Input failed the schema's checks. Only intentional public issue fields are retained.
fix: Correct the reported input issues.

what: A validator threw, rejected, or violated the Standard Schema result contract.
fix: Fix the validator; inspect the private cause for details.

what: Noncanonical base64. No submitted input is exposed.
fix: Use the selected alphabet, correct padding, and zero unused bits.

what: Invalid UTF-8. No submitted text or bytes are exposed.
fix: Pass well-formed text or valid UTF-8 bytes.
